a2-181.title: Communicative Challenge: Greeting Eszter's Grandmother
a2-181.scenario: Carlos arrives at Eszter's grandmother's house in Szentendre. She is standing in the doorway and looks a little tired.
a2-181.prompt: Greet Eszter's grandmother respectfully, ask how she is, and offer her a seat.
cues: Greet her and use the word for grandmother
Ask politely how she is doing
a2-181.target: Jó napot kívánok, nagymama! Hogy tetszik lenni? Tessék, le tetszik ülni?
a2-181.english: Good day, grandma! How are you doing? Here you go, would you like to sit down?
a2-181.canDo: I can use the polite 'tetszik + infinitive' form to address elderly people respectfully.

a2-182.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Is the Post Office?
a2-182.scenario: Carlos wants to post a card to Eszter's grandmother. He stops a passer-by in Szentendre and wants to ask the way to the post office.
a2-182.prompt: Ask the passer-by politely to tell you where the post office is, and thank them.
cues: Ask where the post office is
a2-182.target: Legyen szíves megmondani, merre van a posta! Köszönöm szépen!
a2-182.english: Would you please tell me where the post office is? Thank you very much!
a2-182.canDo: I can use 'tessék' and 'kérem' appropriately in service and public settings.

a2-183.title: Communicative Challenge: Introducing Carlos
a2-183.scenario: Ilona néni, Eszter's grandmother, opens the door and does not know Carlos yet. Carlos's family name is García.
a2-183.prompt: Greet Ilona néni politely and introduce yourself with your family name first.
cues: Greet her politely and use her title
Say your name, family name first
a2-183.target: Jó napot kívánok, Ilona néni! García Carlos vagyok.
a2-183.english: Good day, Ilona néni! I am Carlos García.
a2-183.canDo: I can introduce myself using the Hungarian Eastern name order (family name first).

a2-184.title: Communicative Challenge: Ilona Néni's Name Day
a2-184.scenario: It is Ilona néni's name day. Carlos is standing with Eszter at the table, and everyone raises a glass to the grandmother.
a2-184.prompt: Congratulate Ilona néni on her name day, wish her a long life, and toast to her health.
cues: Wish her a happy name day
a2-184.target: Boldog névnapot kívánok, nagymama! Isten éltessen sokáig! Egészségedre!
a2-184.english: I wish you a happy name day, grandma! May God grant you a long life! To your health!
a2-184.canDo: I can congratulate someone on their Name Day (névnap) using traditional greetings.

a2-185.title: Communicative Challenge: Guest Slippers and Lunch
a2-185.scenario: Carlos has taken off his shoes in the hall. Ilona néni gives him guest slippers, and then lunch is served at the table.
a2-185.prompt: Thank Ilona néni for the guest slippers and wish everyone a good meal.
a2-185.target: Köszönöm a vendégpapucsot! Jó étvágyat kívánok mindenkinek!
a2-185.english: Thank you for the guest slippers! Enjoy your meal, everyone!
a2-185.canDo: I understand Hungarian home visiting etiquette (taking off shoes, gifts, guest slippers).

a2-185-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Welcoming Grandma
a2-185-consolidation.scenario: Eszter's grandmother comes into the room where Carlos is waiting. He wants to be respectful and friendly.
a2-185-consolidation.prompt: Greet Eszter's grandmother respectfully, ask how she is, and wish her a good meal.
a2-185-consolidation.target: Jó napot kívánok, nagymama! Hogy tetszik lenni? Jó étvágyat kívánok!
a2-185-consolidation.english: Good day, grandma! How are you doing? Enjoy your meal!
a2-185-consolidation.canDo: I can use deferential politeness (tetszikelés) and public polite formulas.
